review_comment: When CONTENT_LENGTH header is missing, the code sets length = -1 causing read() to consume the entire input stream without size limits. This change introduces a resource consumption vulnerability where malicious clients can send oversized payloads. Add explicit size validation by setting a reasonable default maximum length or rejecting requests with missing CONTENT_LENGTH.
